item.title: Recognised for broadcasting during the pandemic - Phoenix FM
item.description: West Yorkshire’s Lord Lieutenant recently recognised Phoenix Radio’s contribution to Calderdale life, by maintaining live broadcasting through the COVID-19 pandemic lockdown.

item.title: Phoenix Radio's crowdfunder - Phoenix FM
item.description: Did you support our crowdfunder? Sadly, we still need to pay rent, bills and licence fees, even in lockdown. item.title: Help us at Phoenix FM to raise in the region of £10,000 - Phoenix FM
item.description: Just Giving Campaign to help Phoenix FM to raise in the region of £10,000 to allow us to continue promoting diversity, by supporting marginalised members of the community.

item.title: Summer Time Jam, Phoenix Fundraiser - Phoenix FM
item.description: Join us for an unforgettable afternoon, Saturday 22nd June, at the Lee Mount Care Home as we host the Summer Time Jam. A fantastic family fun day to raise funds for the station in conjunction with our friends and fundraising partners at Lee Mount Care home.

item.title: British Urban Film Festival 2024 - Phoenix FM
item.description: 🎬 Our friends at the British Urban Film Festival (BUFF) will be celebrating their 10th Ceremony this year, with screenings in Halifax.

item.title: Help us raise funds for our new studios - Phoenix FM
item.description: We need your help. We are moving premises and need to build recording studios with very efficient soundproofing. All this can be very expensive and we don’t have the funds currently to do that. We need to raise £1500 for the materials and labour. Any amount donated to our cause would be gratefully received.

item.title: New Studios Update
item.description: First of all a massive THANK YOU for all your generosity and support regarding our new studios fundraising campaign. You managed to help us smash our target of £1500 in just a few days!

item.title: Tribute to Sunday Bandstand's Chris Helme
item.description: Chris Helme was one of our first presenters, hosting the rather unique Sunday Bandstand show, sharing his passion for all things bass band ever since 2007

item.title: New Studios Update - Pre-record studio
item.description: We have set up a new fundraising campaign to help finish our second studio, with the hope of reaching a wider audience this time.
